title: Pure lswarm
summary: lswarm cards only (Evilswarm alongside the Steelswarm cards that share the name), plus staples and an automatic Extra Deck; the page's Fiendsmith engine is left out. The deck focuses on swarm-enabled Rank 4 Xyz Summons centered on Evilswarm Ophion to floodgate Level 5 and higher Special Summons.

summary.title: Starters & Swarmers
points: Evilswarm Castor: Normal Summoned to grant an additional Normal Summon of an lswarm monster during the turn, easily establishing Rank 4 materials.
Evilswarm Mandragora: Special Summons itself from hand if your opponent controls more monsters than you do.
Evilswarm Kerykeion: Banishes an lswarm from the GY to add an lswarm monster from GY to hand and grant an additional lswarm Normal Summon.
Evilswarm Thunderbird: Quick Effect that banishes itself until the next Standby Phase when any card or effect is activated, dodging removal and returning with 300 extra ATK.

summary.title: Opening: Castor into Ophion Lockdown
steps: Normal Summon Evilswarm Castor to gain an extra lswarm Normal Summon.
Normal Summon a second Level 4 lswarm monster such as Evilswarm Kerykeion or Evilswarm Thunderbird, or Special Summon Evilswarm Mandragora.
Overlay both Level 4 lswarm monsters to Xyz Summon Evilswarm Ophion.
Detach one material from Evilswarm Ophion to add Infestation Pandemic or Infestation Infection from your Deck to your hand.
Set Infestation Pandemic to safeguard Ophion against opponent Spell and Trap removal while Ophion floodgates Level 5 and higher Special Summons.

summary.title: Rank 4 Toolbox & Payoffs
points: Evilswarm Ophion: Signature Rank 4 boss that completely prevents Level 5 or higher monsters from being Special Summoned while it has material, and detaches to search any Infestation Spell/Trap.
Evilswarm Bahamut: Detaches one material and discards an lswarm monster to take permanent control of an opponent's face-up monster.
Evilswarm Nightmare: Detaches a material when an opponent Special Summons to change that summoned monster to face-down Defense Position.
Evilswarm Exciton Knight: Quick Effect board wipe that destroys all other cards on the field if the opponent has more total cards in hand and field.
Steelswarm Roach: Rank 4 Xyz that negates the Special Summon of Level 5 or higher monsters.
Steelswarm Origin: Link-2 monster that protects pointed lswarm monsters from destruction and targets, and summons lswarm monsters from Deck when monsters are destroyed.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Infestation Pandemic: Quick-Play Spell searched by Ophion that makes all face-up lswarm monsters you control unaffected by other Spell and Trap effects for the turn.
Infestation Infection: Continuous Trap that shuffles an lswarm monster from hand or field into the Deck to search any lswarm monster once per turn.
Infestation Terminus: Bounces two cards your opponent controls back to the hand by banishing an lswarm monster you control.

summary.title: Left out & Excluded
points: Evilswarm Ouroboros: Omitted due to its Forbidden status.
Fiendsmith engine: Omitted to keep the strategy purely focused on lswarm Rank 4 mechanics and Infestation support.
